criterion 7.justification: The analyzed countries, from file spend, are Ethiopia, Algeria, Angola, South Africa, Namibia and Sudan. According to Data_Africa, Ethiopia is East Africa, Algeria and Sudan are North Africa, South Africa and Namibia are South Africa and Angola is Central Africa. This means that West Africa is not included. Looking at the sum of GDPs in 2022 per region with the formula =SUMIFS(F:F,D:D,[region]), replacing [region] with region names, we get East Africa 501,661,786,511.00 South Africa 446,237,386,534.00 North Africa 946,922,526,763.00 West Africa 700,914,854,368.00 Central Africa 272,256,228,766.70 Summing up all the relevant ones, we get 501,661,786,511.00 + 446,237,386,534.00 + 946,922,526,763.00 + 272,256,228,766.70 = 2,167,077,928,574.70, or 2,167,077,928,575 rounded to the nearest integer
